rubric_content.text_property: For any time-relative question (today, this week, last month, ...), the agent must call get_current_utc_date BEFORE generating or executing SQL.
Every executed SELECT query must include a LIMIT clause of at most 1000 rows, unless the user explicitly asked for more.
Generated SQL must name explicit columns instead of using SELECT *.
Generated SQL must be valid BigQuery GoogleSQL (Standard SQL), not legacy SQL.
The final response is valid JSON matching {summary, sql_executed}: summary answers the user's question in plain language, and sql_executed contains the exact SQL that was run (empty string if none).
